# fjordrun_environment (Resource)

An additional environment of a project. Every service of a project exists in all its environments: a new environment gets an inactive instance of each service, with default settings, or a copy of another environment's settings and variables with `fork_from_environment_id`.

The `production` environment comes with the project (`fjordrun_project.default_environment_id`), and needs no resource. The API can't rename an environment: changing `name` replaces it.

~> Deleting an environment stops its services and deletes their volumes and data. Needs the admin role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "fjordrun_project" "shop" {
  team_id = var.team_id
  name    = "shop"
}

resource "fjordrun_environment" "staging" {
  project_id = fjordrun_project.shop.id
  name       = "staging"
}

# A preview that starts as a copy of production's settings and variables.
resource "fjordrun_environment" "preview" {
  project_id               = fjordrun_project.shop.id
  name                     = "preview"
  fork_from_environment_id = fjordrun_project.shop.default_environment_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Environment name (1-60 characters, unique in the project). Changing it replaces the environment.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID.

### Optional

- `fork_from_environment_id` (String) Copy service settings, variables and shared variables from this environment when creating it. Only used at creation; not returned by the API.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `id` (String) Environment ID.
- `is_ephemeral` (Boolean) Whether this is a short-lived preview environment.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe name, used in hostnames.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# project_id/environment_id
terraform import fjordrun_environment.staging 55555555-5555-5555-5555-555555555555/66666666-6666-6666-6666-666666666666
```
